nodes.name: Saint Peter
nodes.label: Saint Peter
nodes.description: Apostle regarded as first Bishop of Rome and foundation of papal succession.

nodes.name: Saint Paul
nodes.label: Saint Paul
nodes.description: Apostle to the Gentiles whose letters shaped Roman Christianity.

nodes.name: Clement of Rome
nodes.label: Clement of Rome
nodes.description: Early Bishop of Rome associated with the First Letter of Clement.

nodes.name: Pope Leo I (Leo the Great)
nodes.label: Pope Leo I
nodes.description: Pope who strengthened Roman primacy and authored the Tome of Leo.

nodes.name: Pope Gregory I (Gregory the Great)
nodes.label: Pope Gregory I
nodes.description: Pope who reformed liturgy and administration, and promoted missions.

nodes.name: Jerome
nodes.label: Jerome
nodes.description: Scholar who translated the Bible into Latin (Vulgate).

nodes.name: Pope Gregory VII
nodes.label: Pope Gregory VII
nodes.description: Leader of the Gregorian Reform and proponent of papal authority.

nodes.name: Pope Innocent III
nodes.label: Pope Innocent III
nodes.description: Powerful medieval pope who convoked the Fourth Lateran Council.

nodes.name: Thomas Aquinas
nodes.label: Thomas Aquinas
nodes.description: Theologian whose scholastic synthesis influenced Catholic doctrine.

nodes.name: Pope Paul III
nodes.label: Pope Paul III
nodes.description: Pope who convened the Council of Trent and approved the Jesuits.

nodes.name: Ignatius of Loyola
nodes.label: Ignatius of Loyola
nodes.description: Founder of the Society of Jesus, central to Counter-Reformation.

nodes.name: Pope Sixtus V
nodes.label: Pope Sixtus V
nodes.description: Pope known for administrative reforms and urban renewal of Rome.

nodes.name: Pope Pius IX
nodes.label: Pope Pius IX
nodes.description: Pope who convoked Vatican I and reigned during loss of the Papal States.

nodes.name: Pope Leo XIII
nodes.label: Pope Leo XIII
nodes.description: Pope who issued Rerum Novarum and advanced modern Catholic social teaching.

nodes.name: Pope Pius XI
nodes.label: Pope Pius XI
nodes.description: Pope who signed the Lateran Treaty and expanded papal diplomacy.

nodes.name: Pope John Paul II
nodes.label: Pope John Paul II
nodes.description: First Polish pope, globalized the papacy and influenced late 20th-century history.

nodes.name: Pope Benedict XVI
nodes.label: Pope Benedict XVI
nodes.description: Theologian pope who resigned in 2013, emphasizing faith and reason.

nodes.name: Pope Francis
nodes.label: Pope Francis
nodes.description: First Latin American pope, emphasizing pastoral care, synodality, and social justice.
